utility.notes: South San Francisco's own WestLight Energy page confirms PG&E 'still delivers it [electricity] to homes and businesses using existing transmission and delivery lines.' South San Francisco is a well-documented San Mateo County city, consistent with PG&E service already established for other San Mateo County records this session.

value.name: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) - ECOplus (default)
value.notes: Confirmed directly via the City of South San Francisco's own 'Renewable Energy from WestLight Energy' page: 'Under California law, all residents and businesses in South San Francisco, and throughout the county, are automatically enrolled in WestLight Energy.' The default plan is ECOplus (at least 50% renewable). Residents may opt out back to PG&E generation.

permit_authority.value: City of South San Francisco Building Division

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other PG&E-territory records in this dataset.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by PG&E across its entire distribution territory, which includes South San Francisco/San Mateo County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other PG&E-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value: Request an inspection by calling the Building Division main line at (650) 829-6670, option #1

timeline_days.notes: The document states that once fees are paid, the permit is issued immediately/electronically for SolarAPP+-eligible projects, but does not state a specific day-count for non-eligible (regular Building Permit with Plan Check) projects.
